name: lit_petals
description: an ornate rosette of smoothly lit petals, cream and gold in the outer bands and orange, maroon and plum further in, each band a soft dome lit from the upper left with a dark seam between, their edges crusted with small jewel-like decorations in teal, gold and maroon, on a deep teal ground

reference.made_with: an escape-time render signed 'exoteric.roach.org' (Ultra Fractal by its look), 2560x1600

reuses: field smooth through the map by rank, once: the depth order of the reference's rosette (teal ground, cream and gold outer petals, orange, maroon and plum inner ones), read off a cyclic map so the jewels can cycle it
the light layer on field smooth at period 3 with no tube (rings 0, slope 1: the soft formulation, Matt's keep and the default since item 025): every three escape steps one smooth rise, the petal
the same count cycled three times round the map and lit at one step a ring, masked to the set's neighbourhood by the inverted distance estimate at power 25: the jewels
glow_filaments' falloff glow on de, painted near-black and multiplied: the dark hair outlining each jewel
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10

knobs.name: petal_depth
knobs.label: Petal depth
knobs.what: escape steps per lit petal: more makes fewer, broader petals

knobs.name: jewels
knobs.label: Jewels
knobs.what: the cycled jewel colours crusting the petal edges

knobs.name: light_angle
knobs.label: Light direction
knobs.what: where the light comes from, in degrees round the frame (135 is the upper left)

knobs.name: brightness
knobs.label: Brightness
knobs.what: the frame's median lightness, which the tone pass holds the picture to
